# Open Chair Advisory

> Alex Williamson's fractional practice. Alex joins early-stage companies, mostly in health tech and medical devices, and runs go-to-market, product, or business operations until the founder or a full-time hire takes over. Booking new engagements starting February 2027. Contact: arwilliamson9@gmail.com

Recent engagements: founder GTM enablement at Dispatch Care (ICP, positioning, sales collateral, campaigns, conference prep, CRM) a product launch at Kroot (audit, 90-day launch plan, payment strategy, user research, closed beta), and workforce modeling for the reorganization of a national clinical contact center network with 170+ sites.
